title: Famines and Imperial Exams in Ming China, 1521-1619: a spatially explicit panel analysis
description: Reproducible code, aggregate tables and figures for a spatiotemporal analysis of 5,736 Ming famine records and 2,841 normalized 1甲/2甲 Jinshi records on a 1-degree, 114-year grid panel. Includes fixed 1-5 year joint Granger tests, GWR, GeoDetector, an explicit lag-search diagnostic, and a Jinshi rank-encoding audit.
notes: Raw historical event tables are not redistributed. Synthetic sample data (seed 20261113) and figure scripts are included. See docs/data_provenance.md.
